recoveryRoute: Split broad searches into project type: printed boxes, mailer cartons, business box packaging or custom product packaging.
Ask for product dimensions, box style, material direction, quantity range and artwork status before pricing.
Send broad requests to the project review form, not to a generic contact path.
For UK or Europe buyers, confirm target market and retail channel before discussing structure and finishing.
Review high-click zero-conversion terms again after 7-14 days using GA4 key events and Ads search terms.
